description: Create an os-release file at a given path in the tree.
This file format is also used for extension-release files in sysexts
See os-release(5) for details on the format and recognized variables.

path.description: Path to the os-release file to write, relative to the tree root.

extension-release-strict.description: Set to false to add the user.extension-release.strict=0 xattr, relaxing image name matching for sysexts.

vars.description: Variables to set in the os-release file.

NAME.description: A string identifying the operating system.

ID.description: A lower-case string identifying the operating system.

ID_LIKE.description: A space-separated list of operating system identifiers.

VERSION.description: A string identifying the operating system version.

VERSION_ID.description: A lower-case string identifying the operating system version.

VERSION_CODENAME.description: A lower-case string identifying the operating system release code name.

PRETTY_NAME.description: A pretty operating system name in a format suitable for presentation to the user.

ANSI_COLOR.description: A suggested presentation color when showing the OS name on the console.

CPE_NAME.description: A CPE name for the operating system, in URI binding syntax.

HOME_URL.description: A URL to the homepage of the operating system.

DOCUMENTATION_URL.description: A URL to the documentation of the operating system.

SUPPORT_URL.description: A URL to the support page of the operating system.

BUG_REPORT_URL.description: A URL to the bug tracker of the operating system.

PRIVACY_POLICY_URL.description: A URL to the privacy policy of the operating system.

BUILD_ID.description: A string uniquely identifying the system image used as the origin for a distribution.

VARIANT.description: A string identifying a specific variant or edition of the operating system.

VARIANT_ID.description: A lower-case string identifying a specific variant or edition of the operating system.

LOGO.description: A string specifying the name of an icon for the operating system.

IMAGE_ID.description: A lower-case string identifying a specific image of the operating system.

IMAGE_VERSION.description: A lower-case string identifying the image version of the operating system.

DEFAULT_HOSTNAME.description: A string specifying the default hostname for the operating system.

ARCHITECTURE.description: A string identifying the native CPU architecture of the operating system.

VENDOR_NAME.description: The name of the OS vendor.

VENDOR_URL.description: The homepage of the OS vendor.

SYSEXT_LEVEL.description: A string identifying the system extension compatibility level.

CONFEXT_LEVEL.description: A string identifying the configuration extension compatibility level.

SYSEXT_SCOPE.description: The scope of system extensions. A space-separated list of system, initrd, portable.

CONFEXT_SCOPE.description: The scope of configuration extensions. A space-separated list of system, initrd, portable.

PORTABLE_PREFIXES.description: A space-separated list of unit name prefixes for portable services.

PLATFORM_ID.description: A string identifying the platform for which packages are built.

SUPPORT_END.description: The date at which support for this version of the OS ends.

EXTENSION_RELOAD_MANAGER.description: Set to 1 if the extension requires a daemon-reload after merge.

PORTABLE_SCOPE.description: The scope of the portable service.

RELEASE_TYPE.description: The release type of the operating system.

^SYSEXT_[A-Z_]+$.description: A SYSEXT_-prefixed variable identifying properties of the extension itself.
